name: 1623 S. Indiana Avenue — the alley building of the house at 1623 (district draft; refined by T-1946)

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3019, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 20w trace (s20wfp-indiana_1623-b2), the T-3019 census (s20w-1623-rear) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20w-1623; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3019).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3019 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record and no register row: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. 3B on a cross plan, the plan Robinson 1886 draws on the same lot: the main body under the hip, the cross's arms as the fitted plan's wings; the sheet's dashed inner line is not read as a material, and the small frame porch is the refining ticket's. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 480796289 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
